prompt:
ONE single complete 2D RPG game sprite, the exact original MALE REAPER from the references, strict EAST side profile facing RIGHT, WALK OPPOSITE CONTACT-B. This is a new articulated pose of this same model, not a character redesign. Enclosed dark spiked helmet, tall attached teal crest, original black plate armor with elaborate pointed gold trim, armored gold boots, teal-black torn cape behind the legs, huge original cyan crescent scythe with dark-gold shaft. Both original hands grip that same single scythe horizontally at waist height, crescent blade on RIGHT, shaft rear tip LEFT. Whole blade, hands, shaft, crest and every boot inside the image.
CRITICAL LEG ANATOMY: the LARGE FOREGROUND NEAR leg must trail BEHIND towards screen LEFT. Trace that near thigh down-LEFT from the foreground hip, near knee lower LEFT of pelvis, near shin angled down-LEFT, near ankle and gold boot at the LEFTmost ground contact, heel slightly up and toe on ground. The SMALLER BACKGROUND FAR leg must lead FORWARD towards screen RIGHT. Far thigh extends down-RIGHT from behind pelvis, far knee right of pelvis, far shin continues down-RIGHT to the far gold boot at the RIGHTmost ground contact, heel down and toe slightly up. Near thigh crosses IN FRONT at pelvis but continues back LEFT; far forward leg remains behind it at the hip. Do not put the foreground bulky knee on the leading right side again. Keep two separate readable continuous hip-thigh-knee-shin-ankle-boot chains, no missing/shrunken foot, no crossed detached joints. Neutral upright walking torso, not a run or lunge, moderate stride, two planted contacts on a common ground line. Cape lifted slightly BEHIND legs, does not hide thighs or knees. Head and torso face RIGHT, no turn to viewer. Scythe carried, no attack windup.
Exact original black/gold/teal palette, small hand-painted isometric game sprite detail, no skeleton face, no robe redesign, no purple colors. One connected body including gripped weapon and attached hair/cape. No detached particles or glow balls, no ground, cast shadow, mist, aura, writing or sheet. CLEAN TRANSPARENT RGBA, centre figure with very wide empty transparent margins at all four edges. Single complete figure occupies no more than 70% of canvas height and 70% of width. Canvas 1536x1024.
